summary.intent: Resolve all 7 PR review threads on the Phase 38 branch and commit the resulting lint/formatting fixes.
summary.outcome: All 7 CodeRabbit and Copilot review threads resolved with a mix of code fixes, clarifications, and new tests; lint:fix applied and committed.

repo: Project is cipher-box@0.34.0, uses pnpm with eslint/prettier enforced via pre-commit hook and lint:fix script.
Phase 38 and Phase 39 are separate feature branches; vault settings changes in useAuth belong to Phase 39, not Phase 38 — dirty working tree state can cause apparent 'leaks' between branches.
withConflictRetry wraps the entire batch publish operation, making per-item conflict retry logic unnecessary.
IPNS unenrollment must be explicitly called (fireAndForgetUnenroll) for purged entries — it is not automatic.
Publish must be reordered before CID cleanup, and versionCid cleanup must be included alongside CID cleanup.
purgeExpired test coverage is delegated to client-extended.test.ts rather than co-located tests.
workflow: GitHub PR review threads can be bulk-resolved via API calls in a single session.
Running pnpm lint:fix before committing catches Prettier formatting issues that pre-commit hooks would otherwise block.
Checking staged changes before committing (git diff --cached) confirms the scope of a lint-only commit.

friction: A dirty working tree on Phase 38 made it look like vault settings changes had leaked from Phase 39, requiring investigation to confirm no actual commit was misplaced.
open_items: Thread 7 (purgeExpired tests) was delegated to existing coverage in client-extended.test.ts rather than adding dedicated tests — coverage depth may be worth revisiting.
Phase 39 branch with useAuth vault settings changes is still in progress and not yet merged.
